title: 绕心三折
intent: 中心 1 格墙；三鬼分散不共线。1 灯 2 镜绕墙两次折，折线串三鬼。鬼格禁放。
reference: Wall center (2,2). Ghosts (3,0)(4,2)(1,4) non-collinear. Standard: light (0,0) facing E; mirror (4,0) facing 1 (E→S); mirror (4,4) facing 2 (S→W). Path top row through g1 → turn S down col4 through g2 (east of wall) → turn W along bottom through g3. Beam never crosses wall cell.
